items.name: u19
items.text: Grids, type and color: how great pages are made — and the tools that make them.

items.name: u1f
items.text: A good layout is invisible. Here is what is going on underneath the page — from the baseline grid to the paragraph composer.

items.name: u23
items.text: Evening light over layered hills — generated entirely in code for this sample.

items.name: u25
items.text: Every page begins as an empty field of possibility. The grid arrives first: margins that frame the reading area, columns that set the rhythm, and a baseline grid that keeps every line in step from one column to the next. Good layout is quiet. It lets the reader move through a story without noticing the machinery that carries them.Typography does the heavy lifting. A paragraph composer weighs every possible line break at once, trading a slightly loose line here for a much better one three lines later. The result is an even texture of type, free of rivers and ragged gaps, where hyphens appear only when they truly help.Images give a spread its pulse. A strong photograph bleeds off the edge of the page, while smaller pictures sit inside the grid and let the text wrap around them. Captions, pull quotes and running heads add layers that a careful reader can explore at their own pace.Color holds it all together. A restrained palette of two or three swatches, applied consistently to headlines, rules and backgrounds, gives a publication its voice. Spot inks, tints and gradients are all just named swatches, so a single change ripples through every page.Behind the scenes, styles are the secret to working fast. Paragraph styles define the voice of each element, character styles pick out emphasis, and object styles keep frames consistent. Change a style once and the whole document follows, from the cover to the very last page.And when the layout is done, the document must travel: to a printer as a press-ready PDF with bleed and crop marks, to a colleague as an open interchange file, or to a screen as a crisp image. A layout tool earns its keep by making every one of those journeys effortless.Every page begins as an empty field of possibility.
